correctness.rationale: Reconstructed RESULT.md lines 33–86. Rotation stabilizers act freely on positions, so their order divides both 5n+1 and 2n, making the tested quotient integral or a half-integer (integral for even n). For odd n with h=v2(3n+1), the trailing h ones of 3n force precisely the first h−1 carry-outs at positions 1 through h−1; failure means all carry-outs from h on are zero. Recomputed the seven transitions and acceptance under the actual infinite zero suffix: G rejects immediately, while the other six enter D (or remain there). The seven polynomial numerator equations check with constant-term identity matrix; padding to L bits therefore gives z(1+z)/Q, with F_0=0. The primitive C,F,D,G block has characteristic polynomial lambda(lambda−1)(lambda²−1)−1; the other blocks have spectral radius at most 1. The unique dominant simple root gives the claimed positive residue constant and all-cutoff density-zero bound. In the pole argument it is the quotient that has a pole, i.e. Q has a zero. Independently computed math.comb(5*n,2*n) % (3*n+1) for 1 <= n < 4096 and got counts 0,1,2,3,4,6,9,14,21,32,48,73,110 for L=0..12 (branches/d9759b80-6deb-4115-82f1-9370b39e5584/direct_exact_L12.txt). This is only a bounded check; the proof supplies the all-level claims. Frozen VERIFICATION.md and verify.py inspected, not executed.
